description: Measure hold/dup-loan demand and supply on an ecdsa.fail-style reversible op stream, and price Q-cut (width) moves correctly against hold capacity. Use when extending or auditing a hold_pass-type final pass, when pricing a qubit cut against the holds it enables or destroys, when a "shortfall histogram" or demand curve looks suspiciously clean, or before trusting internal consistency checks (sym asserts, relocate 0-failures) as evidence of correctness. Contains the four measured traps: tautological shortfall, uniform-shift vs peak-clip model confusion, pre-loan/with-loan numbering drift, and oracle-only rejection.
